description:
15% rental discount!

Welcome to Angel Gardens, where city living meets elevated lifestyle in the heart of Manchester. Just moments from the Northern Quarter and Ancoats, you're steps away from the city's best cafés, restaurants, boutiques and buzzing bars – everything you need for work, play and everything in between.

Designed with modern renters in mind, Angel Gardens offers beautifully styled apartments in a vibrant, pet-friendly community with standout amenities that support your lifestyle.

Amenities and Benefits:

24-Hour Gym with studios and Technogym kit
Residents' Lounge & Co-Working Area
Rooftop Football Pitch & Residents' Roof Terrace
BBQ Area
Private Dining Room
Onsite Maintenance
Residents' Events
High-Speed Wifi Included
Secure Cycle Storage
Pet Friendly on Odd-Numbered Floors

Whether you're hosting friends on the rooftop, sweating it out in a group class, or co-working with a coffee in hand, life at Angel Gardens is all about balance, community and connection.

City life. Reimagined.

Photos, floorplans and CGIs are indicative only. Please enquire for a full selection of available apartments.

CURRENT OFFER:

The advertised rent includes a 15% monthly discount. Your tenancy agreement will show the standard headline rent; however, only the discounted monthly rent will be payable throughout the promotional period. This offer cannot be used in conjunction with any other promotion and may be withdrawn without notice. Early reservation is recommended to secure this offer.
Viewing Tour disclaimer: This advertisement relates to a specific unit at the stated rent. Where multiple units are available within the same development, you may be shown other apartments during your viewing. Each unit is marketed at its own advertised rent, which will be clearly confirmed to you before any offer is submitted. We do not accept offers above the advertised rent for any property. The rent agreed will always be the advertised rent for the selected unit, in accordance with the Renters’ Rights Act.
